admission._comment: ⚖ the old proxy's values, copied (sessions.md §Capacity): utilization_thresholds 5h = ANTHROPIC_UTIL_THRESHOLD's code default 0.80 (openrouter-proxy.py; unset in its deployment.yaml), 7d = ANTHROPIC_UTIL_THRESHOLD_7D 0.95 (deployment.yaml); latch_429_hold_s = ANTHROPIC_429_HOLD_S 900. reading_stale_s 900 has NO old-proxy precedent (it only drops a reading whose reset passed) — the gateway's own guess, ⚖.

Rules only (GW-CATALOG-GO, operator ruling 5, 2026-10-17): prices, peak rows and hours, per-model monthly limits and the window shares come from the Go catalog snapshot, never from here. latch_429_hold_s = openrouter-proxy.py GO_CAPACITY_HOLD_S 900: the hold a Go 429 that names no reset latches the RAIL for; latch_scope account = a Go 429 latches the whole rail for its retry-after, because every paid Go model draws ONE account allowance and the per-model limits only weight the draw (vendor support, anomalyco/opencode#54875; supersedes the spike's ruling 3 — 2026-11-01, sessions.md §Capacity). windows: the anchors are gometer _GO_WINDOW_DEFAULTS (chain / weekly mon 00:00 / monthly 13 11:30 — self-measured, no vendor source; GO_WINDOW_ANCHORS unset in deployment.yaml), threshold = OPENCODE_UTIL_THRESHOLD's code default 0.80 (unset in deployment.yaml).

providers._comment: GW-RAIL-OPENROUTER §Selection / §Failover (homelab#2741) — the provider floors and the failover bound; the endpoints themselves are the store's snapshot (the catalog leg, homelab#2742), never policy. ⚖ every value: quantization_ladder = OpenRouter's `quantization` vocabulary in ascending precision (a value off it — `unknown` — is excluded); quantization_floor fp8 (operator 2026-10-19: fp8 vs fp8); uptime_1d_floor 95 % of `uptime_last_1d` (a gateway guess — the old proxy's UPTIME_FLOOR read uptime_last_30m); min_rides 5 judged rides before a cell's measured clean rate replaces its uptime prior; max_providers_per_request 3 = one pin + two failovers; tool_choice = the modes each harness's requests carry, every one of which the endpoint must support (opencode / goose: `auto`; claude's anthropic-dialect `any` / `tool` are OpenRouter's `required` / `function`) — verify on the wire.

catalog._comment: GW-CATALOG-OR (homelab#2742) — the registry's SOURCES, never its candidates: account_ref = the labelled Secret holding the openrouter ACCOUNT key the MCP reads ride (the old proxy's ROUTER_ACCOUNT_REF, the same Secret); ranking_slices = the vendor's weekly ranking slices whose union is the ranked set (⚖ programming + tool_calling, operator 2026-10-19); ranking_top_n = per slice, the top N by tokens (⚖ 30 — the old proxy's RANKINGS_TOP_N). Candidates = ranked ∩ AA-benched; the endpoints are read per candidate.

canary._comment: GW-CATALOG-OR §The entry canary (operator 2026-10-19: on demand, budget-capped) — ⚖ every value: role = the prober (the FU-102 role whose rides are probes), harness = the one the openrouter cells serve (opencode); max_per_refresh 3 canary admissions between catalog refreshes; usd_per_day 1.0 of metered canary spend (a canary ride is a few thousand tokens — a dollar a day is ~a hundred of them at the fp8 prices of 2026-10-19); cooldown_s 86400 before an excluded cell is a candidate again; backoff_s 3600 / backoff_max_s 86400 (operator ruling 2026-10-22, homelab#2775: a 429'd canary is NO verdict — the cell's re-try horizon starts at the hour, the budget's own retry unit, doubles per consecutive 429'd canary and caps at the day, the catalog's stale horizon; the ride costs no admission and no tokens, so a throttled cell re-reads itself daily until the provider serves our traffic again).

codex._comment: The ChatGPT-subscription rail (GW-RAIL-CODEX / GW-CODEX-HEADROOM / GW-CODEX-OAUTH, FU-270) — LIT 2026-10-22 as the explicit canary cell (`prober` only, last); EVERY role lists it since 2026-10-23 (operator ruling: subscriptions go to all roles — the walk's harness follows the rail, sessions.md §The harness follows the rail; the spike §Role routing, docs/spikes/codex-subscription-rail.md). The credential is the gateway's OWN login (seed: devbox run codex-seed, #2826; rotations in GATEWAY_DB). ⚖ every value: max_sessions 1 = one codex ride at a time (ADR-139's single replica, one account — kept at the canary's bound while every role may now reach it: a full rail falls through to the next, raise it once live rides show the account's room); headroom.max_age_s 900 = the anthropic admission's reading_stale_s (the same 15-min staleness the subscription rail tolerates); ceiling 0.95 = the anthropic 7d threshold (ANTHROPIC_UTIL_THRESHOLD_7D) applied to both windows — the 5h window's 0.80 is a dispatch-pacing choice the canary does not need yet; windows_minutes [300, 10080] = the two windows the enrolled account's usage payload carries (observed 2026-10-22, the spike §Live usage payload shape); poll_interval_s 60 = one usage GET a minute (15 polls inside max_age_s; the poll reads no quota); oauth.refresh_margin_s 300 = refresh 5 min before the access JWT's exp (a 10-day token observed at the mint). models: DERIVED like the other rails — the candidates are the enrolled account's model evidence (benchmarks.json rails.codex, CODEX_CANDIDATES: the account catalog + a completed turn per id, 2026-10-29), score ascending as the cost proxy.

tiers._comment: GW-MODEL-TIERS (operator rulings 2026-10-18 + 2026-10-19): the four rails' tier LISTS above are DERIVED from benchmarks.json beside this file — `devbox run tiers -- apply` writes them, `-- check` (a test row) fails on a hand edit. score = the Artificial Analysis intelligence index (the one axis with full coverage); bands = a candidate is in a tier when its score >= the fraction x the rail's top score (a model can sit in several tiers); cap = each list's length, cheapest per CLEAN ride first (cost = price x a ride's output tokens / the cell's clean-ride rate + the strike overhead per failed ride; the subscription rails anthropic + codex: score ascending as the cost proxy). A tier with no priced candidate is UNDECIDED and keeps its list (every openrouter tier was, until the first entry-canary window of 2026-10-20 priced 4 of its 28 models at their selected endpoints; `gateway/scripts/canary-entrants.sh` is what admits a cell).

cost._comment: GW-MODEL-TIERS §Cost per clean ride (homelab#2743, operator ruling 2026-10-19: the unit is cost per CLEAN ride, never per token) — ⚖ every value: ride_tokens_out_m 0.01 = 10k output tokens per ride, the 30-day mean per session of the two openai-dialect rails read off the gateway's own ledger on 2026-10-20 (opencode 11.1k, openrouter 13.4k); strike_overhead_usd 0 = the reviewer round + coordinator re-entry a failed ride costs is UNMEASURED (⚑ gap row) — the term exists so the measurement has a home, at 0 the order is price over clean rate; min_rides 5 = judged rides before a cell's measured clean rate replaces its prior (the same number as rails.openrouter.providers.min_rides, two knobs because two rules read them).
